description: One case per toggle: the estate with noReportBackToDriverApp on and nothing else. The known answer is F-DRIVER-REPORT-BACK, the Finding of Check DRIVER-REPORT-BACK, whose severity (Medium) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: noReportBackToDriverApp, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 noReportBackToDriverApp=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The Driver reports Logic App does not report back. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
